blind_spots_patched: Baseline ch-1 only mentioned IEEPA tariff refund reinvestment in passing, omitting the $500M paid, $184M ASC 450-30 recovery, ~$326M pending claims, and three consumer class actions (Stockov, Gower, Ortiz) plus 27.5% non-U.S. FX translation exposure.

Baseline ch-2 noted California's 26% U.S. sales share but omitted that U.S. & Canada combined generate 83% of consolidated net sales and operating income, and that Citibank, N.A. is the exclusive U.S. co-brand credit card issuer funding February member rebates.

Baseline ch-3 omitted two unit-economics drags: accrued member rewards rose 13.4% YoY to $3,037M (outpacing 10.1% net sales growth) and sub-one-hour third-party delivery (Instacart, Uber Eats, DoorDash) shares fulfillment economics.

Baseline ch-5 missed Audit/Governance director Helena B. Foulkes's Nov 7, 2026 resignation, the Oct 16, 2026 FY2027 Executive Bonus Plan ($1.2M CEO / $400k EVP cash cap), and Oct–Nov 2026 Form 4 RSU/EVP activity.

Baseline ch-6 omitted the jump in current portion of long-term debt ($2,248M vs. $75M in FY2025) ahead of the $13.3B special dividend, undiscounted captive self-insurance reserves, and active PAGA/pixel/opioid/IEEPA litigation.
